cards.text: Elisha the prophet calls over one of the sons of the prophets and hands him a job. Tuck your cloak under your belt, take this flask of oil, and go to Ramoth-gilead. That's the whole briefing, friend: a flask and a city name, which is barely more instructions than I got in all my years in the junk drawer.

cards.question: Elisha tells the young man who to look for once he gets to Ramoth-gilead. Who is it?

cards.text: Elisha says to go in and get Jehu away from his companions. Whatever this is, friend, it is NOT a group announcement.

cards.question: Once the young prophet gets Jehu away from his companions, where does Elisha tell him to take Jehu?

cards.text: Then the flask comes out: Elisha says pour the oil right on Jehu's head and speak the LORD's words. Walk up to an army commander and pour oil on his HEAD? Friend, that takes more nerve than I've got in my whole mustache.

cards.question: With the oil on Jehu's head, the young prophet is to declare: "This is what the LORD says: I anoint you ___ over Israel."
After he anoints Jehu, Elisha tells the young prophet to stay and wait for Jehu's answer.

cards.text: So the young prophet heads to Ramoth-gilead and walks in on the army commanders, all sitting there together. He says he has a message for the commander, which is like walking into a room FULL of managers and asking to speak to the manager.

cards.question: When the young prophet says he has a message for the commander, Jehu asks which of them it's for.

cards.text: "For you, commander," comes the answer, so Jehu follows him into the house, and the oil goes on his head with the LORD's word: "I anoint you king over the LORD’s people Israel." Friend, Jehu didn't apply, didn't interview, didn't even get a heads-up, and he just got the BIGGEST promotion in the country.

cards.question: The LORD gives Jehu his first job as king: strike down the house of his master. Whose house is it?
What reason does the LORD give Jehu for striking down Ahab's house?

answers.text: To avenge the blood of His prophets
To win back the land from Aram
To give Israel a stronger army

cards.text: Ahab was king of Israel (1 Kings 16:29), Jezebel was his wife (1 Kings 16:31), and the LORD says that blood was shed by Jezebel's hand. Now the whole house of Ahab will perish, made like the houses of Jeroboam son of Nebat and Baasha son of Ahijah.

cards.question: The LORD says someone will give Jezebel a proper burial.

cards.text: On the plot of ground at Jezreel the dogs will devour her, and there will be no one to bury her. Then the young prophet opens the door and RUNS, just like Elisha said, and I respect a man who follows instructions all the way out the door.

cards.question: Jehu walks back out to his master's servants, and they ask him: "Is everything all right? Why did this ___ come to you?"

cards.text: Jehu brushes it off, like it's just prophet babble, and they fire right back: "That is a lie!" and "Tell us now!" I bet they saw that man SPRINT out of the house, friend, so Jehu tells them the LORD's words: he's been anointed king over Israel.

cards.question: Quickly, each man takes his ___ and puts it under Jehu on the bare steps.
Right there on the steps, the men blow the ram's horn and proclaim Jehu king.

cards.text: One minute Jehu's sitting in a meeting, the next he's got a crown and a pile of garments under his feet. And that's where we'll leave it for now, friend, because this story is NOT done.
